title: Il Registro Italiano di Dialisi Pediatrica (RIDP) - Italian Registry of Pediatric Dialysis
official: Il Registro Italiano di Dialisi Pediatrica (RIDP) - Italian Registry of Pediatric Dialysis
summary: The primary aim of the Registry, in addition to promoting collaboration and the sharing of protocols among participating centres, is to collect epidemiological, clinical, and biochemical data on patients, as well as technical data on dialysis treatments performed at Italian dialysis centres.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

\- Age under 18 years at the initiation of the first course of chronic kidney replacement therapy (dialysis or pre-emptive kidney transplantation).

Exclusion criteria:

\- Duration of kidney replacement therapy of less than 30 days before any potential drop-out.
